    Settings

    While you move things, they line up with the canvas edges and center and with other layers, and a pink guide shows the match. Hold Alt (Option) while dragging to move freely.

    When off, IMGEDTR switches back to Select after you draw a shape, so you can adjust it right away. Pen, highlighter and step markers always stay on (Esc or another tool when you are done).

    IMGEDTR

    Turn off any shortcut that clashes with your system (for example Chromebook shelf keys).

    IMGEDTR is a lightweight image editor for marking up screenshots and photos.

    Private by design. Your images never leave this device. There are no uploads, accounts or analytics, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

    The only outside code is the HEIC converter (libheif, via the heic-to library), downloaded once from jsDelivr the first time you open an iPhone photo, checked against a fixed fingerprint, then kept for offline use.

    Projects. Save project keeps everything editable in an .imgedtr file. A project also keeps the original pixels under any Redact box, so share exported images, not project files.

    Built-in fonts. Atkinson Hyperlegible, Montserrat, Poppins, Comfortaa, Oswald, Anton, Bebas Neue, Playfair Display and Pacifico (SIL Open Font License 1.1) and Permanent Marker (Apache License 2.0), from Fontsource, are stored inside the app, so text in them never needs a download.

    Part of a family of browser tools that all work this way - see More apps.
